pages.text: $(l:materials/memory_core)$(c)$(o)Concentration Cores$() aren't only useful for weaponry - instead, they can be used more creatively too. The Litter is one such example. It's a critter that will follow its user around, leaving behind Light Droppings whenever in dark areas. It can also be picked up. An Inhabiting Ritual is required to create it, which needs a block that constantly emits light, 12 Linear and 4 Curved Ritual Blocks.

pages.name: Inhabiting Ritual
pages.text: To trigger the ritual, use the Concentration Core on the chosen light emitting block.
